quest.title: The Championship Begins
quest.description: Following a tranquil stay in Nod-Krai, you check in with Katheryne to see if anything noteworthy has happened lately.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x425, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! How can the Adventurers' Guild help you today?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been a while since we last came to see you! Got any exciting commissions for us?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Things have been rather quiet in Nod-Krai lately. The commissions currently on our books are all very routine.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: That being said, the Frostmoon Scions are preparing to host some sort of event. They have approached us with quite a number of requests for supplies. Apparently, it's going to be quite a large gathering.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Frostmoon Scions? Well, it can't be another Moon-Prayer Night... Do they have some other big festival that Paimon doesn't know about?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I heard it's a friendly sparring competition for animal friends. Something called the "Spirit Envoy Championship."

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: That's right. The Frostmoon Scions have always advocated coexistence with nature, encouraging their followers to build positive relationships with the beasts of the wild.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: At the same time, to ensure their animal friends build the strength to withstand hardship and disasters, they put select animals with whom they share a special bond through a unique sort of training.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: The "Spirit Envoy Championship" is designed to find the strongest human-animal pair by means of friendly sparring.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: In previous years, the competition was restricted to the Frostmoon Scions only, but this year, participants from all over Teyvat are invited to join. I understand that the Frostmoon Scions have even prepared a generous prize for the winner.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh... Does that mean we can join, too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? You want Paimon to fight!?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: While you two certainly share a remarkably deep bond, I believe that would be against the rules...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Apparently, in a previous competition, someone entered an extremely rare and powerful partner... After this, the rules were clarified to state that only common animal species and their variants can compete.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I guess that rules out Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah... Wh—What a shame, huh! Paimon was totally looking forward to making a super cool entrance and then *cute fighting noises* "Paimon is the winner"! Sucks that the rules got in the way... Looks like Paimon won't get a chance to show off her skills. Unlike, uh, all those other times...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway... Who else do we know who might wanna take part?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If you're unsure of what to do, why not ask one of our advisors for help?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Advisors? Since when does the Adventurers' Guild have advisors?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Hehe... The Guild has always had a team of advisors on hand to assist our fledgling adventurers.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Of course, few of them would be qualified to assist such world-renowned adventurers as yourselves. But as luck would have it, one of our top advisors has recently returned to Nod-Krai from a trip away.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Her expertise is varied and broad, and she often gives lectures at Speranza. If you have any questions, you could try asking her for help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She sounds impressive... Heh, but you're right Katheryne, it would take a lot to teach us something new.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go put this mystery adventure advisor to the test!

choices.text: Time to put you through your paces, Paimon!

talks.objective: Go to Speranza and find the mysterious Advisor

dialogues.text: Alright then! Next, let's go over some more tips for adventuring in Nod-Krai.
If you found yourself getting hungry in the wild, what are some things you could eat?

dialogues.speaker: Zelibrat
dialogues.text: That's easy — Lakkaberries, Midsommar Berries... There's loads of options.
Correct! 10 points to you!
Ya-ho!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That must be who Katheryne was talking about... She looks pretty young for an advisor, though. How knowledgeable can she really be?

dialogues.speaker: Orvokki
dialogues.text: But there are plenty of places where berries don't grow, right? What should we be looking for in those places, Miss Linnea?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Good question — I'm glad you asked. That's exactly what I wanted to talk about next. Does everyone recognize this mushroom?

dialogues.speaker: Zelibrat
dialogues.text: Hmm... Based on the color... this is an edible one, right? Doesn't look poisonous to me...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Eh-ehhh... Wrong answer!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: This here is a Browncap Mushroom. It looks harmless enough, but eating it will give you hallucinations.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: An unsuspecting adventurer once used a handful of these to make a pot of mushroom soup. Next thing you know, he was trying to foxtrot with the Wild Hunt... Luckily, he was spotted by a fisherman passing by who managed to save his life, but it was a close call.

dialogues.speaker: Zelibrat
dialogues.text: That sounds so dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: You bet! Adventuring in the wild is no joke. Alright, onto the next — does anyone recognize this plant? Can you tell me if it's edible?

dialogues.speaker: Zelibrat
dialogues.text: Isn't that a Winter Icelea leaf?

dialogues.speaker: Orvokki
dialogues.text: They say that the King of Winter Icelea and the King of Midsommar Oak are sworn enemies. If Midsommar Berries are sweet and delicious, I guess Winter Icelea leaves must be horribly bitter...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, Paimon knows the answer to this one! Winter Icelea leaves might not taste good in food, but you can brew a nice tea with them!

dialogues.speaker: Zelibrat
dialogues.text: Huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: At the Flagship. Once when Paimon was eating some yummy food there, Demyan mentioned that one of the drinks in their Roulette Special has Winter Icelea in it.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Hmm? Who are...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: ...Looks like we have an expert attending our Q&A session today! Well, I hope you're ready for the next question?
Ya-hoho...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bring it on!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Every adventurer knows to pack a compass and a map before heading into the wilderness, but where would you go to buy these things?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem! Listen up, everyone! The answer is... the Adventurers' Guild!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Oh, really? But I hear Mimisbrunnr Books sells them too. And at a very low price!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah! Paimon's done her research. The boss of that place tries to pass off cheap knockoffs as the real deal — don't be fooled!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Well said. But even with a high-quality map and compass, the wild can still be a dangerous place. What should you do if you're being chased by a monster you can't fight off?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Seek help from the ratniki on patrol.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Correct! Although the ratniki's main duty is to deal with the Wild Hunt, you can always ask them for help if you run into serious trouble.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: While we're on the subject, some adventurers have found they can use the territorial nature of Radiant Beasts to their advantage. Lure a monster into their territory, and they will fight each other instead of you. I wouldn't recommend doing this, though, as you may instead find yourself fighting two enemies instead of one.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Final question! This is an important one. Which place in Nod-Krai is an absolute must-visit for travelers from abroad?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Just one?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oof, that's a tough choice! There's the Frostmoon Enclave, Starsand Shoal, Blue Amber Lake... They're all so pretty! Then there's the Voynich Guild, The Flagship... And so many other shops worth visiting!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: In truth, there's no right answer to this question. But if you ask me, the place most worth visiting is right here — Speranza.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Why? Simple — this was once my home. So, this final question was more like a little bit of shameless self-promotion, hehe.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: You can get delicious Nod-Krai Hot Dogs and Lakkaberry Madames. And if you're not too hungry, just order a slice of Midsommar Torte and listen to the entertaining rumors the children like to tell.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: That's it for today's lecture. Tomorrow, I'll be heading to the Frostmoon Enclave to take part in a competition. If you have any questions, you can ask at the Adventurers' Guild, where the other advisors will be happy to help.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I haven't met many adventurers who can keep up with me. Consider me impressed!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Likewise! You really know your stuff! You're everything Paimon would expect from an Adventurers' Guild advisor... Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What's the deal!? Don't get so close! {NICKNAME}, there's something wrong with her!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Hehehe... Actually, I was going to ask...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Your little friend is so clever and cute. I love how she flies around, too. Can I pet her?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Stay back!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Don't be afraid. Hehe, I'm not gonna hurt you. Come on, come here...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Hehe... Ahem. I'm sorry, I got a little bit carried away again.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: My name's Linnea. I'm an advisor working for the Adventurers' Guild. Uh... And I promise you, I'm not some sort of weirdo!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: ...Lemme make it up to you. You want something to eat? Here, try some Midsommar Torte, it's delicious.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew, you gave Paimon a fright... Paimon's never met someone so, uh... how to put this... "enthusiastic" as you.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I was fighting to keep a lid on my curiosity during class, but then I just lost control...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Anyway, let's get this back on track. Could you tell me your story? How did you two meet?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (You tell Linnea how you and Paimon met...)

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: What? You fished this little cutie out of the sea?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Can you tell me where? A visit to that beach is going right to the top of my bucket list.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You'd be wasting your time — Paimon is one of a kind! You could sit on that beach for a hundred years, but you'd still come away empty-handed!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Ah... Is that right? What a pity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! Paimon almost forgot why we came here. We were thinking of taking part in the Spirit Envoy Championship ourselves. Katheryne said you could give us some pointers?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let Paimon guess... Is that your partner there?
Ya-ho?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Yep! Her name is Lumi. She's my trusty assistant.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I've never seen a creature like this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Hey there.

response.speaker: Lumi
response.text: Ya-ho!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Have you two ever ventured north of Nod-Krai?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not yet... Wait, so you're saying Lumi comes from the northern tundra?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Pretty much. There are six types of fae commonly found in the tundra. Lumi here is a "Jack Frost" — that's one of them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Jack Frost"? Hmm, interesting name choice... She doesn't exactly look very frosty.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: An excellent observation. In fact, Lumi is no ordinary Jack Frost — she's a special one.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: The first time I met her, she was wearing this weird cardboard outfit with ugly splotches of paint on it, as if she was trying to disguise herself as a regular Jack Frost.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I stayed and watched her for a while, and I discovered that some other mean Jack Frosts were ganging up and bullying her because she looked different. They stole all the food she'd gathered and kicked her out of her sleeping spot...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Lumi couldn't fight them. She had nowhere else to go, so she found an old cardboard box, painted it blue, and put it over her head, hoping to blend in with the group.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Whenever she was discovered, she'd get beaten up, and the rest of the time she lived in constant fear... Until one day, seeking shelter from the rain, she clung to me and wouldn't let go. We've been partners ever since.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What a story... Oh, poor Lumi. Sounds like she's had a tough time.

response.speaker: Lumi
response.text: Ya-ho!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: As for why Lumi is so different from other Jack Frosts... I'm still looking into that. I'm thinking it's either a mutation or an atavism — or maybe some sort of curse?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Hopefully, I'll find the answer one day. But either way, we're best friends for life. Nothing can change the special bond between us.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Speaking of which — given how long it can take to build a strong bond with another creature, if you're serious about entering the competition, my advice is to pick an animal friend that you're already pretty close with. Otherwise, the odds are gonna be stacked against you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: An animal friend I'm close with, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, we're kinda spoiled for choice on this one! Who do you think would be the best fit?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (I need to consider this carefully...)
Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh...? Aguara! What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Aguara
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Aguara
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Oh, neat! A Natlanese tepetlisaur! Aw, it's so small and cute!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: He seems to really like you guys. I'm sure he'll make a great partner.

response.speaker: Lumi
response.text: Ya-ho!

response.speaker: Aguara
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, look at them, fast friends, hehe! Play nice, you two!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: They both seem pretty sociable. No wonder they get along so well.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Well then, there's no time to lose — let's go get you signed up!

choices.text: You want to join the competition?
You said you're going to the Frostmoon Enclave for a competition?
Please go back to acting like a teacher.

talks.objective: Go to the arena at the Frostmoon Enclave

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Paimon wasn't expecting this many people...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! What a nice surprise! I didn't think I'd run into you here!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, and Professor Linnea's here too! Are you guys here for the competition as well?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Um, yep, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Feels like we haven't seen you in ages, Mualani! So how do you know Linnea, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Through her work with the Adventurers' Guild. She was in Natlan not long ago. She knows so much that we took to calling her "Professor."

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, you never answered my question... If a koholasaurus and a qucusaurus got together, would their babies be able to fly in the sky and dive underwater? 'Cause that would make a pretty awesome saurian companion!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: That's almost certainly impossible... They're completely different species...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ah, well, that's too bad. Hear that, Mamala? Guess I can't do any match-making for you in the Flower-Feather Clan after all...

dialogues.speaker: Mamala
dialogues.text: Awoo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you have a thing for qucusaurs!?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! I was wonderin' what all the commotion was. Looks like this is where it's at!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Itto!? What the heck? Either Paimon's seeing things, or... You're not here for the competition too, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Why else would I be here? Cost me an arm and a leg to get a boat all the way to this "Krod-Nai" place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's "Nod-Krai."

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Hey there! I'm Mualani. Are you a friend of {NICKNAME} and Paimon's, too?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I sure am. Nice to meet ya! The name's Arataki "Beetle Gladiator" Itto, head honcho of the world-famous Arataki Gang of Inazuma!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That's quite a mouthful!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: (Wait, did he say "Arataki Gang"? Why does that sound so familiar...?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just call him Arataki Itto. This guy's a bona-fide buffoon.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey! Who are you callin' a buffoon, ya flying Lavender Melon!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: ...Flying Lavender Melon? Wait, so you're some sort of... mutated lavender melon? You don't look like a melon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's not a mutated melon! Or any kind of melon! How could a melon be this cute?

choices.text: So, Itto — are you here on your own?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Yeah, about that... Unfortunately, the gang only had the funds to send their main man this time. But don't sweat it! Once I snag that championship title, I'll use the prize money to bring Shinobu and the boys over to join the party!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Shinobu...? Ah! I remember now! Kuki Shinobu, right? She's mentioned the Arataki Gang before.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh? No way, you've met my deputy?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: She stopped by the Flower-Feather Clan recently to take the flying trial. Chasca said she was a natural!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: ...Hold on, if she's that good and she's only the deputy... you must be way stronger than I imagined. Look sharp, Mamala — we're in for a tough competition!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahahaha! That's right! Bring it on — I'm looking forward to seeing who I'll be facing in the finals.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Word is that the early birds get the best draws. You snooze you lose! Laters, compadres!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Wait, is he serious? ...Mamala, we'd better hurry!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: N—No, that's complete nonsense...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: *sigh* ...Shall we?

choices.text: Where's the rest of your gang?

talks.objective: Sign up for the Spirit Envoy Championship

dialogues.speaker: Voitto
dialogues.text: Thank you all for signing up for the "Spirit Envoy Championship."

dialogues.speaker: Voitto
dialogues.text: Due to the high number of participants, a preliminary qualifying round will be held to determine which 16 contestants will progress to the competition itself. Prior to the semi-finals, all matchups will be determined by drawing lots.

dialogues.speaker: Voitto
dialogues.text: Please also note that there are two arenas, which will be randomly assigned after the draw. Do you have any questions?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where do we go to draw lots?

dialogues.speaker: Voitto
dialogues.text: Right here. After registration closes tomorrow, make your way here to draw lots for the qualifiers. I wish you all the best of luck in the competition!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Lumi, Aguara, how you doing? Nervous?

response.speaker: Aguara
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Lumi
response.text: Ya-ho!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Great, that's the spirit!

talks.objective: Draw lots for the preliminary round

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who do you think our first opponent is gonna be?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon hopes they aren't too strong... Aguara might need some time to ease into it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! The results of the draw are out! Let's take a look... Your opponent is:

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Arataki 'Numero Uno' Itto"!? Ugh, we literally just managed to get rid of him, and now you have to face him in the arena?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Looks like we won't be facing him in the finals then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Well, either way, it never pays to underestimate your opponent, okay? This is your first match, so be sure to make it count!

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Ahh, I see you've been assigned to Arena 1. I'm in Arena 2. Guess I'll see you after the match.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Good luck! Don't fall at the first hurdle now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We won't! Good luck to you and Lumi, too!

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: Welcome, spectators! I'm your host, Czeslawa. The qualifiers are about to begin. I trust everyone has found their groupings.

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: #The contestants for this match are: {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} partner Aguara, versus... uhh... Arataki "Numero Uno" Itto and his partner Crimson Staff!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! Well, this has come sooner than expected. I was hoping to face you further into the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Go, Crimson Staff!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can do it, Aguara! You show that beetle who's boss!

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: Great energy from both contestants! Now, without further ado, let the match commence!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Dodge left, Lumi!

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-ho!

dialogues.speaker: Ilze
dialogues.text: How did you know I was gonna—

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Now counterattack! Pummel it!

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-hoho...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Looking good. Let's do this!
...Hmph.
Ignorance really is bliss, isn't it Linnea... But it won't last forever...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Why is she staring at Linnea? Do they know each other?)

dialogues.speaker: Alzbeta
dialogues.text: And it's all over! We have a winner!

dialogues.speaker: Alzbeta
dialogues.text: Congratulations to Linnea and Lumi! You're through to the next round!

dialogues.speaker: Ilze
dialogues.text: I can't believe it... My Iku-Turso...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Good job, Lumi!

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-ho!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, how did your match go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haha, we won too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You and Lumi were really in sync.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Thanks, that means a lot! Yeah, I think we performed pretty well out there. Not just Lumi — I was really in the zone today.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I dunno how to explain it, but... Sometimes, it feels like I can predict my opponent's next move. I know exactly what to do before I've even had the time to think.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It's almost like I enter a different state of mind. It comes and goes, but it started after I met Lumi in the tundra... Anyway, congrats to both of us on getting through the qualifiers!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Come on, let's head to Speranza — my treat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hurray!

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Wooraarr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aguara!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! How 'bout that, huh? Victory for Arataki "The One and Oni" Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: Hold up.

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: Uhh, the bull... Ushi, was it?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Uh, yeah... Is there a problem?

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: #Arataki Itto is disqualified for fielding an additional animal companion. {NICKNAME} and Aguara are the winners!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: It's one animal per contestant, that's the rule! Let this be a warning to everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But... but me, Crimson Staff, and Ushi are one! We should only count as one contestant! Hey! Ah, come on...!

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: Time out.

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: Uhh, the bull... Ushi, was it?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Uh, yeah... Is there a problem?

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: #Arataki Itto is disqualified for fielding an additional animal companion. {NICKNAME} and Aguara are the winners!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: It's one animal per contestant, that's the rule! Let this be a warning to everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But... but me, Crimson Staff, and Ushi are one! We should only count as one contestant! Hey! Ah, come on...!

dialogues.speaker: Aguara
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: Stop the match!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: Uhh, the bull... Ushi, was it?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Uh, yeah... Is there a problem?

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: #Arataki Itto is disqualified for fielding an additional animal companion. {NICKNAME} and Aguara are the winners!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: It's one animal per contestant, that's the rule! Let this be a warning to everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But... but me, Crimson Staff, and Ushi are one! We should only count as one contestant! Hey! Ah, come on...!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Woohoo, you've got some moves, I'll give you that! But it's gonna take more than that to defeatto the Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: It's time to unleash our show-stopping killer combo move! Ushi! Crimson Staff!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Crimson Staff, look, I wanted to kit you out with mecha armor, but you need to bulk up first. That's why we've gotta take on these tough opponents — to get you strong!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ushi, you and me have crushed countless foes in our time. Now, with the three of us together, ain't no one gonna stand in our way!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Finish them!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I got here first!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: No way, my Sharky Surfboard clearly beat you to it!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! Well, I'll see you in the arena! Just don't go crying like a baby when you lose.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Did you hear that, Mamala? Argh, show them no mercy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jahoda! Here for the competition?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jahoda?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ahem, I'll have you know it's "Champion" Jahoda.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Champion?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Don't you know? This isn't my first Spirit Envoy Championship. Uh-huh, I took part in the last one... And not just that — I only went and won the entire competition! It was very heroic.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Although, there were nowhere near as many contestants then... Ugh, why did so many people have to show up this time!? How am I gonna keep my title now?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's amazing! We'll definitely have to learn a thing or two from you.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Haha, heh, yeaaah...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: This is the biggest turnout we've ever had by far. We need to be extra vigilant to maintain order in the arenas.

dialogues.speaker: Czeslawa
dialogues.text: I've made all the necessary arrangements.

dialogues.speaker: Alzbeta
dialogues.text: I'm feeling more nervous than I expected...

dialogues.speaker: Slawomir
dialogues.text: Don't worry, you'll be fine once you get into the swing of it.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Thank you all for your support. Be sure to let me know at once if any issues arise.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I—I can't believe it... My glorious journey ended at the first step...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's your own fault for not reading the rules...

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ushi, Crimson Staff... Are you guys tryin' to cheer me up? Well, don't you worry! We'll come back stronger than ever next time, and I'll lead us to a glorious victory, fair and square!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Anyway, seeing as we came all this way, I think a little sightseeing is in order! Hahaha, let's go get ourselves a taste of Krod-Krai culture!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously? Again, it's "Nod-Krai"!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you actually have any Mora left?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Uhhh... Well...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ahem... Hey, Lavender Melon! I've got a little, uh, proposition for ya—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way! If you want Mora, go earn it like everyone else!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Pffft, fine, don't lend me anything then! Watch me, I'll figure something out. This is a small pond — and Arataki Itto is the biggest fish around!
